name: Intertwined
description:
About This Game

Two warriors. One fate you cannot escape.

Choose between Seren and Umbra—rivals bound by a force neither can sever. They despise each other, hunt each other, and yet… cannot exist apart. In a world fractured by their separation, every step forward brings them closer to the same inevitable end.

Game Features

  • Fully controllable spear. Spawn when you want, aim where you want, throw where you want. 

  • Hunt the one who walks your path. Every step forward narrows the distance between you and the inevitable final clash.

  • Master a spear that answers in any direction—strike, throw, and recall with precision to control both combat and space.

  • Move through a world that fractures and reshapes as balance breaks, where shifting paths, unstable terrain, and distortions challenge your sense of direction.

  • Feel the presence of your rival in moments that don’t belong to you—unexpected actions, echoes in combat, and subtle intrusions that blur control and intent.

  • Push deeper into interconnected regions filled with hidden routes, layered shortcuts, and secrets that reward careful exploration.

  • Face enemies twisted by a reality that cannot hold itself together, each demanding different strategies and precise execution.

  • Confront brutal encounters that test your mastery, where hesitation is punished and control determines survival.

  • Decide how the conflict ends—your actions shape the outcome, and every resolution carries consequences that cannot be undone.
short_desc: A 2D metroidvania where your final boss is the character you didn’t choose. Play as Seren or Umbra—Master directional spear combat, explore a broken world, and uncover the truth behind your bond.
